title: Followers/Following Modal
content: Build followers/following list modal. Tabs: Followers and Following toggle. User list: avatar, name, username, follow button per user. Search: filter list by name. Mutual indicator: "Follows you" badge. Actions: Follow/Unfollow toggle. Sort: recent first or alphabetical. Loading: paginated loading.

variants.simple: Create modal listing followers or following with actions.
variants.detailed: Build followers/following list modal. Tabs: Followers and Following toggle. User list: avatar, name, username, follow button per user. Search: filter list by name. Mutual indicator: "Follows you" badge. Actions: Follow/Unfollow toggle. Sort: recent first or alphabetical. Loading: paginated loading.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive followers/following list modal with interactions. Trigger: clicking follower/following counts on profile opens modal. Modal structure: max-w-md w-full, max-h-[80vh], bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl. Header: "Followers" or "Following" title based on context, close X button. Tabs: "Followers (1.2K)" and "Following (456)" tabs with counts, underline active tab. Search: search input below tabs, placeholder "Search", filters list as typing, debounced. User list: overflow-y-auto flex-1, divide-y. User row: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3. Avatar: w-10 h-10 rounded-full, click navigates to profile (closes modal). User info: flex-1, name (font-medium), username (text-gray-500 text-sm), bio preview (optional, text-xs text-gray-600 line-clamp-1). Mutual badge: "Follows you" badge (bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 text-xs px-2 rounded) if they follow you (in Following tab) or if you follow them (in Followers tab). Follow button: Follow/Following toggle button, Following shows on hover "Unfollow" in red. Remove follower: in Followers tab, dropdown with "Remove follower" option. Loading: initial list shows skeleton rows, infinite scroll loads more (paginated API). Empty state: "No followers yet" or "Not following anyone" with appropriate suggestion. Sort options: dropdown - Recent, Alphabetical. Filter options: Mutual only, Verified only. User preview hover card: on desktop, hovering username shows mini profile preview. Bulk actions: if admin/self, select multiple and remove. Close modal: clicking outside, X button, or escape key. Mobile: full-screen modal (inset-0 rounded-none), back button instead of X. URL state: modal state in URL for sharing (/profile/user/followers). Counts update: if follow/unfollow occurs, counts update in real-time. Performance: virtualize list for users with 100k+ followers. Accessibility: modal traps focus, list navigable, follow status announced.
